hero.eyebrow: Messaging and social APIs for developers
hero.title: One API for the channels your customers already use
hero.subtitle: Connect Facebook Pages, Instagram accounts and WhatsApp numbers once, then send and receive messages, publish posts and read insights through a single REST API with webhooks.

features.title: The platform work, done once
features.description: Vesact holds the platform apps, the permissions and the review history. You hold an API key.

channels.title: Connected accounts
channels.description: Your customers authorize their Facebook Pages, Instagram accounts and WhatsApp business numbers through Vesact's Meta app. TikTok and YouTube follow.

api.title: One REST API
api.description: Conversations, messages, posts and metrics share one shape across platforms. Versioned under /v1, described by an OpenAPI document.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Incoming messages, comments and delivery results arrive at your endpoint as signed events, with request ids for tracing and idempotency keys for safe retries.

keys.title: Keys, limits and usage
keys.description: API keys belong to your organization. Rate limits, quotas and usage are visible in the console, and billing follows the accounts you connect.

how.title: Three steps from sign-up to production

connect.title: Connect accounts
connect.description: Create an organization in the console, issue an API key and let your customers connect their platform accounts through the hosted authorization flow.

call.title: Call the API
call.description: Send messages, publish posts and read metrics with the same request shapes on every platform.

receive.title: Receive events
receive.description: Register a webhook endpoint and process incoming messages, comments and results as they happen.

cta.title: Start building on Vesact
cta.description: Sign in with Google, create an organization and issue your first API key in a few minutes.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.description: Questions about the API, a platform you need, or your data: write to us and we answer within two business days.
